notes.key_messages:
To maximise their chances of success on this paper, candidates should:
• select carefully only the information from the text that answers the question, in particular in the last two
exercises
• look carefully at when material needs to be manipulated to answer the question
• remember that questions follow the order of the text.
notes.general_comments:
Candidates appeared to have sufficient time to complete the paper, and almost all candidates were
appropriately entered for the examination. There were few instances of candidates leaving more than a
couple of questions blank.
